INSTITUTIONAL · RESPONSIVE
01 / THE BRIEF

Built for trust.

Government and institutional sites serve a wide range of visitors, from first-time internet users to officials. That means plain structure, readable content and layouts that work on any device.

This project took me into that environment and added a very different set of priorities to my usual product work.

Responsive designInformation architectureFormsBackend / API integrationDeployment
“When the audience is everyone, clarity is the whole design.”
THE BUILD PRINCIPLE
02 / WHAT I BUILT

What this kind of work demands.

Projects like this lean on a consistent set of fundamentals, and I apply them to each build.

  • Professional, accessible UI and a clear information architecture.
  • Responsive design and well-organised content sections.
  • Forms with backend and API integration.
  • Deployment and security considerations.
Content→Structure→UI→Forms & APIs→Deploy
WHAT THIS PROJECT BROUGHT TOGETHER

Information architecture

Content grouped so people find things quickly.

Responsive UI

A professional interface that works across devices.

Deployment

Taken live on its own domain.

03 / THE TAKEAWAY

What it
taught me.

Working in an institutional setting reinforced that good engineering is mostly good fundamentals: structure, performance, security and a deploy you can trust.
